chapter: New Orleans bands, Oliver and Armstrong
title: The New Orleans clarinet's harmony role
summary: Rose explains that pre-1915 clarinetists sought note-for-note harmony with the cornet lead, as Harry Shields and Johnny Dodds approached. Players lacked time to rehearse and had little musical education.
